stories.title: Over 550,000 people join nationwide cost-of-living protests across France, with violent clashes in several cities
stories.reason: Police detained 195 people in Paris alone, including 13 minors, while a tourist office was torched in Lyon and a government building stormed in Marseille, as Interior Minister Lecornu warned the student movement was turning into a wave of urban violence ahead of France's 2027 presidential election.

stories.title: Trump signs an executive order waiving new Russia sanctions days before they would have taken effect
stories.reason: The order suspends the Graham Act's tariffs of up to 500% on Russian goods and other sanctions Congress passed by large margins, drawing bipartisan condemnation including from GOP Senator Thom Tillis, as Zelensky said he felt Trump was 'rewarding Putin.'

stories.title: Putin declares Russia is building a non-negotiable 660-kilometer 'security zone' inside Ukraine
stories.reason: The zone spans parts of Ukraine's Sumy and Kharkiv regions, about 70% already under Russian control, with Putin explicitly ruling it out of any future talks as Ukraine's foreign ministry said the move shows Moscow isn't meaningfully interested in peace.

stories.title: Nine former FBI employees sue the Trump administration over firings tied to the Mar-a-Lago documents case
stories.reason: The plaintiffs allege FBI Director Kash Patel orchestrated politically motivated retribution against staff who worked the investigation, seeking reinstatement after being dismissed in February without internal review or a chance to contest their termination.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude autonomously redesigned quantum circuits, cutting gate counts by up to 17 times
stories.reason: Working in a 53-hour closed loop with only plain-language specifications, the model beat previously published designs on seven of eight tasks, including replacing Google's extended Euclidean algorithm with Berlekamp-Massey to cut gate count roughly 12-fold on one decoder.

stories.title: DeepSeek releases its V4.1-Flash-1017 model with open MIT-licensed weights and a new search API
stories.reason: The update beat the prior Flash version on all 11 benchmarks DeepSeek reported while cutting output length, and opened its proprietary search and fetch APIs to outside developers for the first time at $0.75 per thousand calls.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves the hospital four days after lung cancer surgery
stories.reason: Doctors confirmed the 71-year-old pontiff had adenocarcinoma after removing the lower lobe of his right lung, and while he's been cleared to return to the Vatican for Sunday's traditional blessing, tests on whether the cancer has spread are still pending.

stories.title: An EU summit erupts into open clashes over migration as Denmark, Italy and Poland challenge Spain's plan to regularize 600,000 migrants
stories.reason: Macron warned that politicizing the debate was dividing the bloc, but leaders left Brussels with no deal on the next seven-year budget and no fresh Ukraine funding commitments, exposing deepening rifts even as they tried to project unity behind Zelensky.
